earnings.title: Keurig Dr Pepper Reports Q3 Results and Reaffirms Guidance for 2026
highlights: Delivered Q3 Diluted EPS Increase of More Than 20%
Net Sales $7.34 bn $18.63 bn $7.34 bn $18.63 bn
Net sales for the third quarter increased 70.6% to $7.3 billion and, on a constant currency basis, net sales advanced 70.1%.
Excluding the contribution from the JDE Peet’s acquisition, legacy KDP net sales increased 8.6%, driven by volume/mix growth of 6.5% and favorable net price realization of 2.1%.

quotes.text: We are pleased with our third quarter results, which featured meaningful net sales and EPS growth, along with healthy free cash flow. Our refreshment beverages portfolio maintained its double-digit sales growth momentum and we drove solid results in coffee, led by strong JDE Peet’s profitability.

outlook: For 2026, KDP expects net sales of $25.9-$26.4 billion and constant currency Adjusted diluted EPS growth in a low-double-digit range.

This guidance now includes approximately $8.3-$8.4 billion in net sales and a 7 to 8 percentage point EPS growth contribution from the JDE Peet’s acquisition, as well as 3-5% constant currency EPS growth for KDP's legacy business, due to revised expectations for U.S.

items.heading: Disruption of our manufacturing and distribution operations or supply chain, including increased input costs, may adversely affect our financial condition or results of operations.
We operate in highly competitive categories, and any inability to compete effectively could adversely impact our business.
We may not effectively respond to changing consumer preferences and shopping behavior, which could impact our financial results.
Concerns about the safety, quality, or health effects of our products could negatively affect our business.
Damage to our reputation or brand image can adversely affect our business.
If we do not successfully manage our acquisitions of and investments in new businesses or brands, our operating results may adversely be affected.
